parsed.change_summary: Added `std::quoted` around the `url` variable in line 14 to escape any special characters that could be used to inject arguments into the command.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The use of `std::quoted` ensures that any quotes or special characters in the `url` are properly escaped, preventing them from being interpreted as part of the command string. This neutralizes the argument delimiters and mitigates the risk of command injection.
